chapter: Paris scene and a visit home, 1937-39
title: Back at the Chez Florence among five kings; Paris as entertainment capital
summary: Returning in spring, the band played for kings and royalty at the Chez Florence; Butler describes Paris as the hub of entertainment with Eddie South and Benny Peyton passing through.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So we finished our contract and then we -- now this is springtime, we goes back into Chez Flordes, the place is called Chez Flordes. This is our place, that's where we were located there in Paris. It was the kings and all royalty. King George, Prince of Wales. I went down there, there were four kings, five kings in the place, King ____, King of Rumania, King Carol, King George of Greece, King George V of England, King Philip of Spain. And I think that was the number there.

We come in in the springtime, around March, April, May. It's a beautiful time in Paris. Everybody got to their apartments. Now we're in Paris. Now at that time Paris was the capital of Europe -- the hub for entertainment. In fact, anybody who was anybody even come to Paris, and the money was good. If the money was bad or not, it was beautiful there in France. People like Eddie South, the black angel, he would be coming in from Hungary and you have a fellow named Benny Payton, he's coming in from India..
